summary: OceanaGold Corp filed a Form 6-K on May 12, 2026, reporting high-grade drill results from its Haile Gold Mine exploration program, including conversion and extension drilling at Horseshoe Underground and Ledbetter Underground, and initial drilling at Clydesdale. The filing is a routine operational update on exploration progress, with no terms, prices, or strategic transactions. There is no board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics. The press release announces drill hole highlights, but this is not a special situation event — it is standard resource update news.
